videos.title: Personal Protective Equipment in the Farm (PPE) || TLE 7 & 8
videos.relevance: Designed for grades 7-8 students, covers farm PPE (gloves, boots, goggles) in an educational tone — perfect age and topic match for Req 1a.

videos.title: Managing Farm Safety and Health Video Series - Workshop Safety
videos.relevance: Short (2 min) farm workshop safety video from an agricultural extension service — covers ventilation, fire safety, and layout principles directly relevant to Req 1b.

videos.title: ANSI Standards: Safety Signs and Labels
videos.relevance: Covers DANGER/WARNING/CAUTION signal words and ANSI label formats — directly addresses the safety symbol identification required in Req 1c.

videos.title: ISO Symbols for Safety Signs and Labels
videos.relevance: Covers ISO safety pictogram system — complements the ANSI video by showing universal warning symbols Scouts need to identify on equipment for Req 1c.

videos.title: Safety Data Sheet Training: A Crash Course On Chemical Safety Data Sheets (SDS)
videos.relevance: Under 3 minutes, crash-course format explaining what an SDS is and why it matters — concise and youth-appropriate for Req 1d.

videos.title: How Diesel Engine Actually Works? (Animation)
videos.relevance: Animated explainer showing the diesel four-stroke cycle — compression ignition, fuel injection, power stroke — exactly what Req 2a asks Scouts to explain.

videos.title: What is Hydraulics and how does it work? | Hydraulics in Physics
videos.relevance: From a channel designed for youth (STEM KIDS), covers Pascal's law and hydraulic principles in under 3 minutes — ideal age and topic match for Req 2b.

videos.title: Which transmission should I choose?
videos.relevance: Short comparison of hydro vs power reverser vs gear shift tractor transmissions from a Kubota dealer — directly covers the transmission types discussed in Req 2c.

videos.title: How to Care for and Sharpen Gardening Tools
videos.relevance: Demonstrates sharpening with a file, cleaning, and oiling hand tools in 3 minutes — covers the core skills (filing, sharpening) required in Req 3.

videos.title: Routine Tractor Service
videos.relevance: Short (3.5 min) routine tractor service walkthrough — oil, filters, grease — from a trusted tractor educator. Covers the maintenance tasks in Req 4.

videos.title: Career Profiles: Agriculture Equipment Technician Lee Bryan
videos.relevance: From a youth-focused agricultural education org (2 min), shows a real ag equipment tech at a dealership — prepares Scouts for their dealer visit in Req 5.

videos.title: Tractor Tip Tuesday: Connecting Quick Couplers
videos.relevance: Beginner-friendly demonstration of hydraulic coupler connection on a tractor — directly relevant to Req 6 Option A (tightening hydraulic fittings).

videos.title: Introduction to Ag Careers: Agricultural Engineer
videos.relevance: From Farmamerica/Junior Achievement youth career exploration program — covers agricultural engineering career path, designed for the Scout age group.
